say:1:1623138001:1.text: I sometimes swing by Holt Street just for a walk. It always has the cutest animals there and they'll happily make friends with anyone.
say:1:1623138001:1.source_cn: 霍尔特商业街总会有一些非常亲近人的动物，我偶尔会过去看看。

say:2:1623138002:1.text: I'm buried in student papers lately... Could you check on them for me if you've got a minute?
say:2:1623138002:1.source_cn: 最近我忙着审阅学生论文……如果你路过那里的话，能不能替...

say:3:1623138003:1.text: One more thing before you go. Take this with you! There's a snow-white dog around. Give it a bite of this, and it'll stick to you like glue!
say:3:1623138003:1.source_cn: 噢对了，如果你碰到一只纯白的狗，这是它平日比较爱吃的东...
